description: nhflow_3d_curv_waves_relax_map30 (regular waves H 0.02 m, T 1 s, d 0.5 m in a flume of 200 x 4 x 10 cells on a mapped grid turned by 30 deg, relaxation zones B 107 / B 108) with the semi-implicit non-hydrostatic step (A 510 11, dt 0.02 s; needs patch v50). Second order in space on a curvilinear grid: at 15 cells per wavelength the waves arrive out of phase with the explicit step, at 30 cells the heights agree within 3 %. Since patch v52 with the second-order time levels (tl2) on the curvilinear grid.
covers: the coupled eta-phi system on a curvilinear grid with relaxation zones and open ends
nhflow_momentum_SI_nhcurv.cpp with a varying cell size
